metadata.title: Compliance Policy Guides Index
metadata.topic: Guidance · FDA devices, foods, veterinary and tobacco
metadata.legal_basis: FDA Compliance Policy Guide (CPG) (21 CFR 10.115). Guidance states FDA's current thinking and is not binding unless a statute or regulation requires it; the official text governs.
metadata.applicability: Products: Animal & Veterinary, Biologics, Cosmetics, Dietary Supplements, Drugs, Food & Beverages, Medical Devices, Radiation-Emitting Products, Tobacco. Topics: Investigation & Enforcement

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.
